Validate physical/information and current action/resource prerequisites.
Commit actual Action/Reaction and26RP plus real cadence/surcharges once.
Apply ordered local procedure with separate roll/payload/causal transaction records.

procedure.ending: NEW one active interval. A nested Time Stop declaration rejects before cost; no recursive rolls/turns, extension or queued grant. At final personal turn end, dismissal, caster Incapacitated/dead, actual parent suppression or successful source-qualified dispel, close once, discard unused personal opportunities, retain costs and all completed acts, and resume exact paused queue. Suppression terminates this indivisible interval rather than parking extra turns to replay. A failed/countered opening creates no interval. Antimagic origin prevents opening after payment; entering an actually active field with caster body closes immediately. Deferred clocks resume from their original world deadlines; no simultaneous catch-up just because personal turns occurred. Due events completed before opening remain completed. Haste remains on its normal clock and grants only its actual regular-turn Action; genuine ending still imposes its accepted Stun cost once.
procedure.immunityPeer: NEW local interface proposal: an actually source-qualified Time Stop-immune participant is not frozen. Each temporal round supplies it one independent extra turn after the caster in stable prior initiative/ID order, with the same finite personal wallet and no regular refresh. It can move, act, counter during a real later cast, or end the interval through a legal effect. Universal uninterrupted excludes stopped outsiders, not a genuine specific immunity. Timeless Form’s native minute and immunity to time stop/haste/slow are preserved; immunity suppresses only this spell’s freeze/denial contribution, not all time rules. Its operative acquisition, original cast, duration and resumption profile must already be demonstrated. The current index still holds Timeless Form; this proposal does not accept it or manufacture a usable immune actor. That required positive branch is TF192-B01, so Time Stop is unaccepted in this return.
procedure.interaction: NEW actual voluntary movement, ordinary free/paid object interactions, spells and legal attacks remain useful. Move only along supported legal geometry; handles/doors/items change their same physical records, custody never duplicates. Frozen targets retain actual AC/defenses; stopping time is not Unconscious, an automatic hit/critical or a new attack advantage. A necessary passive defense/check resolves as atomic resistance, not target agency, Reaction or turn. Immediate attack/HP/condition/custody deltas settle once. Normal saves, damage roots, Wounds and concentration consequences remain required; no postponed duplicate payload. Moving a body needs an actually legal carrying/shove/grapple source, capacity and support. Autonomous delayed projectiles/environmental clocks remain paused. Unknown collision/capacity holds that branch.
procedure.modes: KEEP three placements under one identity. Wizard Illusion and Druid/Mage Transmutation use Action and one explicit d4+1 roll giving 2–5 temporal rounds. Cleric Universal uses Reaction and grants exactly three personal turns. NEW Universal trigger: immediately after a discrete, perceived other-creature Action or movement segment fully resolves within120ft and line of effect, before the next atomic event; never react to another temporal grant, administrative event or your own action. Harm already resolved stays resolved. Its real Reaction and ordinary counter window occur before the interval establishes. No free cross-school mode choice.
procedure.scope: NEW resolve everyone-but-you literally as a single-world scheduler pause, not a120ft-radius field. Action modes target the caster and use120ft as retained conflicting metadata, not a fabricated area. Universal120ft bounds its triggering event. Ordinary-world creatures, unattended processes, projectiles, environmental motion and remote scenes stop advancing at one committed boundary. This is an operational clock policy, not a claim about planes/cosmology. Validate every currently loaded affected clock adapter before commitment; unsupported live domains hold that scenario. Offscreen state cannot be assumed absent in a real campaign.
procedure.turns: NEW each temporal round supplies one caster personal extra turn with one ordinary Action, one Bonus Action only for a genuinely acquired use, one free interaction and current Speed movement. Universal supplies three such turns. These are authentic source-granted extra turns, NEVER regular starts or extra-full-Action grants. No Reaction, recharge, death save, rest, numbered-round entitlement, Haste extra Action or finite resource refresh. Keep stance and shared numbered-round allowances. Personal Action/BA/movement wallets are separate from the interrupted ordinary wallet; retain that original wallet on resume, with actually spent shared Reaction/resource changes. World-clock endpoints and six-second pulses, including the caster’s ordinary deadlines, pause; personal turn ending can end only an explicit this-actual-turn effect. New absolute durations anchor to the paused world instant and first progress after resume. No new numbered ordinary round is fabricated.

sharedRequirements.access: Keep every native placement and classAccess row. Rank9/minimum class17/base26RP, V/S/F; Action except the actually acquired Universal Time Stop Reaction. Wizard access uses the class-mapped school, actual spellbook entry and prepared matrix; Druid uses its prepared list; Cleric/Mage use actual known choices. A class-level/rank gate or enough RP is not acquisition. Proposed spell preparations in fixtures are explicitly contingent on this static review and do not alter current catalog availability. No unprinted consumed component or generic upcasting.
sharedRequirements.clocks: World elapsed time is monotonic except it is paused during the explicitly authored Time Stop interval; no time is rewound by bookkeeping. Ordinary regular starts/end markers, six-second recharge, death saves, Ready, persistent pulses, source-relative duration, rest and finite-use histories remain separate clocks. Each full-state case records actor schedules and all due starts/ends, or explicit outside-initiative elapsed ticks. An administrative event is not a turn. Natural1/20 attack/save/task/opposed meanings remain exact Core rules; all dice in examples are authored inputs, not executed gameplay RNG.
sharedRequirements.commit: Before commitment validate live body, actual class/repertoire, Action or exact Reaction trigger, audible V, free gesture hand, possessed focus, targets/geometry and adequate resources. Compute limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); surcharge1 at limit and2 at limit+3; ordinary ranked casting blocked at limit+6. Base strain2 for rank9; consecutive same-name Refrain1,2,3 capped; Wizard first actually prepared family waives base only. Preserve real class exceptions and mandatory hooks. Pay once, update history once, end incompatible concentration only if this cast requires it, then offer real cast-time counters. Countered, interrupted or later-invalid legal casts keep payment/cadence and never restore displaced concentration. Invalid preflight pays nothing. Ordinary eligible Wizard Arch Counterspell is rank1/3RP/Reaction/recharge2, INT+PB task vs10+2rank, not an acquired ordinary spell by name; its actual acquired feedback/bonuses still apply.
sharedRequirements.persistence: Serialize source/cast/parent/child IDs, original clock domain/endpoint, immutable rolls and lineage, source/version references, complete bodies/resources/conditions, audit histories, custody and per-observer memories, pending transactions and obligations. Save/load and mode transitions preserve them byte-semantically; no cost, pulse, draw, award or grant replays. Copies of a document are not copies of a body, resource wallet, item, reward or guarantee. Missing engine adapters remain engineering qualifications, never false evidence of execution.
sharedRequirements.physical: Real occupied body volumes, support, hands, item identities, custody, focus, sight/line of effect and source range are checked at their actual stage. Fixture actors are explicit source-qualified human class builds and scene premises, not discovered campaign characters or invented creature profiles. Missing actual campaign operands create a whole dependent case/branch hold. No camera/debug knowledge, hidden identity revelation or fabricated objective fact. Default real-world/campaign input is unknown until supplied; a synthetic scene is labelled as such.
sharedRequirements.ready: Only Action-time modes can use ordinary Ready. Spend Action, commit actual cast once including costs, cadence, components and counter window; hold concentration even for a normally nonconcentration spell. At release, after the actual perceivable trigger, spend legal Reaction and recheck all targets/geometry. No second cast or payment/counter window. Effect duration begins on release; Ready expires at original next regular own-start. Invalid/declined triggers spend no release Reaction, without extending that deadline. Replacing, concentration loss, expiry or countering loses the held spell without refund. Universal Time Stop cannot be generically Readied.
sharedRequirements.scope: Static authored review of only time-stop, fate-rewrite, collapse-timeline and eternal-prophecy at 816 applied / 32 pending / 0 accepted-unapplied; 540 standalone procedures; 173 scoped interfaces. These four proposals remain held and unapplied. No closed cohort or global interface is changed.
sharedRequirements.suppression: Use exact accepted Antimagic Field RW149-F, not the name Null as a universal dispel. Legal originating-inside casts still pay but their ordinary payload is suppressed without banking release. Creature-attached expressions suppress on actual body intersection; clocks remain original. A current qualified dispel uses its actual source/rank/cost/check and real effect perception; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3/3RP/60ft/recharge2/INT+PB vs10+effect rank for rank4+, not Greater Dispel. Residual Null/Null Veil affects its explicit exposure/damage-root scopes, not every temporal effect. Instantaneous completed physical/history changes are not undone by later suppression. Preserve root-dealer Null flags, no duplicated outcomes and all inherited source holds.
